name: Wenzhou Yihua Connector Co., Ltd.
summary: Wenzhou Yihua Connector Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of communication connector and its components in China. It produces network connectors, including RJ11, RJ45 plug/jack, RJ45 integrated transformers; USB, HDMI, DP, and cardholder; optoelectronic connectors such as SC, LC, MPO, SFP, SFP+ and other SFP series products and high-speed cables, and automotive connectors. The company also offers USB, HDMI, DP, card slots, optoelectronic connectors (SFP series products), electrical power connectors (terminal blocks, power sockets), consumer electronics wiring harnesses, industrial and automotive electronic wiring harnesses, and other related products.
